{{Quote|And you'll have a great story to tell&hellip;or sell. How I Saved Luke Skywalker. By Darth Vames.|Han Solo to Tarth Vames|<ref name="lash" />}}
'''Tarth Vames''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking pad]] chief on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. He attempted to prevent [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] from landing due to terms of his exile from the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. Later, when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]] came looking for Luke and Ben, they enlisted Vames' help in tracking them down, as well as securing guides and supplies for the journey.<ref name="lash" />

Solo often referred to him as 'Darth Vames' much to his annoyance.<ref name="lash" />
